### New Features ✨

#### Components

- Add split panel by @natemoo-re in [#128834](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128834)
- Add menu by @natemoo-re in [#128833](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128833)
- Add spinner by @natemoo-re in [#128817](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128817)

#### Conversations

- Show extraction spans like decision spans by @ArthurKnaus and @cleptric in [#128989](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128989)
- Merge decision span tabs into one by @ArthurKnaus in [#128985](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128985)

#### Dashboards

- Resolve prebuilt dashboard configs through a flag-aware helper by @edwardgou-sentry in [#128923](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128923)
- Persist widget query transformations by @nsdeschenes in [#127565](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127565)
- Add flag for web vitals dashboards on trace metrics by @edwardgou-sentry in [#128921](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128921)
- Add a low-priority query control by @wmak and @cursoragent in [#128953](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128953)

#### Explore

- Persist transformations in saved queries by @nsdeschenes in [#128806](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128806)
- Remove compare links and refine trace query controls by @nsdeschenes in [#128752](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128752)

#### Inbox

- Add item and event type registries by @cvxluo and @codex in [#129050](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129050)
- Add InboxItem and InboxItemEvent models by @malwilley in [#128925](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128925)

#### Integrations

- Add delete button to custom integration details page by @dcramer with @sentry-junior in [#129048](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129048)
- Instrument commit issue resolution by @giovanni-guidini in [#128757](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128757)

#### Investigations

- Add XOR actor references by @Zylphrex in [#129024](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129024)
- Draw the status block as a thinking block with the agent's reasoning by @billyvg and @claude in [#128436](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128436)
- Outline an investigation by its headings by @billyvg in [#128465](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128465)

#### Issues

- Fetch issue tag values through TanStack Query by @scttcper and @claude in [#128957](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128957)
- Make comment mutations independent of GAL rows by @shashjar in [#128087](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128087)

#### Other

- (action-log) Backfill FIRST_SEEN during derived data regen by @kcons with @sentry-junior in [#127279](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127279)
- (admin) Add Clear Pending Pay-as-you-go customer action by @noahsmartin in [#128980](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128980)
- (ai-monitoring) Add runtime selector for Pi Durable onboarding by @cleptric in [#128344](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128344)
- (api) Add an endpoint owner map that resolves inherited owners by @akhilp117 in [#129026](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129026)
- (auth) Add deprecated scope translation layer by @DominikB2014 in [#128663](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128663)
- (formulas) Add suggested values to formula params by @k-fish in [#129000](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129000)
- (middleware) Report requests that grow worker RSS by a lot by @mwarkentin and @claude in [#129053](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129053)
- (native) Add project option to apply source server info by @mujacica in [#128692](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128692)
- (onboarding) Use @sentry/agent-plugin in tracing and logs empty states by @bcoe with @sentry-junior in [#129059](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129059)
- (preprod) Add mark-as-viewed for snapshot review by @mtopo27 and @claude with @sentry-junior in [#127259](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127259)
- (repository) Add canonical reference resolver by @giovanni-guidini in [#128993](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128993)
- (scraps) Add rule against component and DOM selectors by @TkDodo in [#128234](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128234)
- (seer) Add a get_commit_author RPC for Seer Agent PRs by @joseph-sentry with @sentry-junior in [#128776](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128776)
- (seer-explorer) Add /investigate command by @billyvg in [#128928](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128928)
- (settings) Add scope navigation rail by @priscilawebdev with @sentry-junior in [#128341](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128341)

### Bug Fixes 🐛

#### Hybridcloud

- Catch invalid RPC circuit breaker config by @valencitas and @claude in [#128938](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128938)
- Run RPCs without a ViewerContext the receiver can't parse by @gricha in [#128970](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128970)

#### Investigations

- Drop DOM-coupled selectors from text block layout by @billyvg with @sentry-junior and @getsantry in [#129001](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129001)
- Line up text block embeds with query block cards by @billyvg with @sentry-junior in [#128892](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128892)
- Close off a query table when prose follows it by @billyvg and @claude in [#128547](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128547)

#### Other

- (backup) Make relocation dependency scope invariants actually assert by @skaasten with @sentry-junior in [#128896](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128896)
- (dashboards) Tell the generate agent to scope named projects via the projects field by @skaasten with @sentry-junior in [#129020](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129020)
- (drawer) Cover docked Seer and respect page banners by @priscilawebdev and @billyvg with @sentry-junior in [#128984](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128984)
- (dropdown) Close submenus with Escape and Left Arrow by @priscilawebdev in [#128987](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128987)
- (issues) Type tag values as nullable by @scttcper and @claude in [#128948](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128948)
- (lint) Use scraps primitives in makeLazyloadComponent spec by @scttcper with @sentry-junior in [#129072](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129072)
- (objectstore) Only proxy object requests for registered usecases by @jan-auer with @sentry-junior in [#128920](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128920)
- (replay) Don't build a Replayer for loading or empty replays by @gggritso with @sentry-junior in [#128811](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128811)
- (routes) Stop remounting lazy routes on first re-render after load by @DominikB2014 in [#126635](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126635)
- (scm) Pick the code-mapping integration by its matching repository by @vaind in [#128328](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128328)
- (seer) Resolve GitLab repositories by stable identity by @giovanni-guidini in [#128994](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128994)
- (workflows) Validate unregistered action types by @kcons in [#129049](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129049)

### Documentation 📚

- (discover) Document events and Discover endpoints by @DominikB2014 with @sentry-junior in [#128036](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128036)

### Internal Changes 🔧

#### Aci

- Drop the retired `Incident` table by @shashjar in [#128387](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128387)
- Retire the remaining `Incident` model definition by @shashjar in [#128399](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128399)
- Consolidate detector handler tests around the new lifecycle by @saponifi3d in [#127135](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127135)

#### Alerts

- Move `AlertRuleTrigger` to pending deletion by @shashjar in [#128602](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128602)
- Move `AlertRuleTriggerAction` to pending deletion by @shashjar in [#128601](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128601)

#### Flags

- Remove `organizations:tracemetrics-units-ui` registration by @cursoragent, @cvxluo and @nsdeschenes with @cursor and @sentry-junior in [#126379](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126379)
- Remove `organizations:tracemetrics-stats-bytes-ui` registration by @cursoragent, @cvxluo and @nsdeschenes with @cursor in [#126429](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126429)
- Remove `organizations:tracemetrics-stats-bytes-ui` (frontend) by @cursoragent, @cvxluo and @nsdeschenes with @cursor in [#126428](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126428)
- Remove `organizations:tracemetrics-units-ui` frontend reads by @cursoragent, @cvxluo and @nsdeschenes with @cursor in [#126378](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/126378)
- Collapse organizations:gen-ai-conversation-title-generation reads by @cursoragent and @cvxluo with @cursor in [#128942](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128942)

#### Seer

- Remove request wrappers for deleted Seer endpoints by @azulus and @claude with @sentry-junior in [#128975](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128975)
- Remove the GHE integration config from the org seer-rpc registry by @azulus and @claude in [#129030](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129030)
- Remove the seer-gitlab-support feature flag registration by @joseph-sentry with @sentry-junior in [#127632](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127632)
- Read the retired code mode "on" override as "only" by @azulus and @claude in [#128836](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128836)
- Remove the /code-mode-on command from Seer Explorer by @azulus in [#128838](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128838)
- Remove seer-gitlab-support checks from the frontend by @sentry-junior in [#127626](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127626)
- Replace GitLab webhook debug_log with plain logger calls by @joseph-sentry with @sentry-junior in [#127625](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127625)
- Remove seer-gitlab-support gating from GitLab code review webhooks by @joseph-sentry with @sentry-junior in [#127624](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127624)

#### Other

- (✂️) Update knip by @TkDodo in [#128358](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128358)
- (api) Extract shared transformation pipeline parsing by @nsdeschenes in [#128883](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128883)
- (apidocs) Add structured output for the API input lint rules by @akhilp117 in [#128815](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128815)
- (auth) Simplify dashboard scopes to read and write by @DominikB2014 in [#129012](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129012)
- (dashboards) Label query priority as Normal and Faster by @wmak and @cursoragent in [#129051](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129051)
- (deps) Bump rrweb dependencies to 2.45.0 by @Lms24 in [#128986](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128986)
- (grouping) Add and update Unity grouping test inputs by @lobsterkatie in [#129052](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129052)
- (integrations) Normalize SCM provider metric values by @giovanni-guidini in [#128889](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128889)
- (issues) Drop removed `post-update` option from comment commit test by @shashjar in [#129031](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129031)
- (preprod) Build size analysis detector on DetectorHandler evaluation by @saponifi3d in [#127134](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127134)
- (runner) Pause GC during boot and freeze the boot heap by @mwarkentin and @claude in [#127145](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/127145)
- (scraps) Extract toast provider and API by @TkDodo in [#129033](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129033)
- (settings) Offer read and write levels for dashboard tokens by @DominikB2014 in [#129013](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129013)
- (timeseries) Add more instrumentation by @wmak in [#128996](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128996)
- Bump sentry-protos to 0.97.0 by @getsentry-bot with @sentry-release-bot and @sentry-junior in [#129075](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129075)
- Bump sentry-conventions to 0.30.0 by @getsentry-bot and @msonnb with @sentry-release-bot in [#129006](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129006)
- Bump sentry-protos to 0.96.0 by @getsentry-bot with @sentry-release-bot and @sentry-junior in [#128976](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128976)

### Other

- chore(provisioning) Remove non-outbox based analytics creation by @markstory in [#128997](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128997)
- dep: upgrade granian to 2.8.6 by @gi0baro in [#129021](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129021)
- o11y(slack-investigation): Send start refusal counts to Sentry too by @alexsohn1126 in [#129002](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/129002)
- o11y(slack-investigation): Count why investigations can't start by @alexsohn1126 in [#128998](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128998)
- chore(db) Make new_repository_id not null and add indexes by @markstory in [#128548](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128548)
- revert: Stop producing the unknown actor type (#128931) by @gricha in [#128979](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/128979)

## 1.17.1 (October 28, 2026)


BUG FIXES:

* fmt: The original content of a file is now preserved if Terraform experiences an error writing to the original file. ([#39303](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/issues/39303))

* Always evaluate module policies during destroy plan ([#39455](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/issues/39455))

* stacks: report every policy result for a replaced resource instead of only one of them ([#39453](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/issues/39453))

[RELEASE] Released version 3.5-dev10

Released version 3.5-dev10 with the following main changes :
    - BUG/MEDIUM: stats-file: shm-stats-file be counters not working anymore
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: rearm packet on packet received even non ack-eliciting
    - REGTESTS: use HAPROXY_TEST_TIMEOUT for wait in purge srv/be
    - BUILD: sym: Make sure minidebug works correctly with most environments
    - BUILD: sym: Use dl_iterate_phdr() for more OSes.
    - BUILD: sym: Get it to build and work on various OSes
    - BUILD: sym: Make sure __always_inline always is inline.
    - BUILD: sym: Build properly with gold as a linker
    - BUILD: sym: Keep a temporary binary without .gnu_debugdata
    - BUILD: sym: Don't add a minidebug section to haterm and haload
    - MINOR: quic: use the listener for Retry and Version Negotiation emission
    - MINOR: quic: define a function to emit a datagram on a listener socket
    - BUG/MEDIUM: quic: use datagram destination as source for Retry
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: use datagram destination as source for stateless reset
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: use datagram destination as source for version negotiation
    - REGTESTS: quic: check Retry source address on a wildcard listener
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: handle EINTR on emission of packets without connection
    - MINOR: quic: rename confusing qc_purge_txbuf() to qc_flush_txbuf()
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux_quic: prevent uaf on fctl frame after send error
    - BUG/MINOR: mux_quic: prevent RS/SS on unistream with hq-interop
    - BUG/MINOR: check: do not inspect errno if conn FDLESS
    - BUG/MINOR: mux_quic: do not crash on SE_SHR_DRAIN shut
    - MEDIUM: quic: implement the AEAD confidentiality limit
    - OPTIM: quic: use native HKDF APIs where available
    - TESTS: quic: add HKDF unit tests using RFC 5869 vectors
    - BUG/MEDIUM: peers: keep the earliest sync task deadline
    - DOC: config: explain per ACL line limitations
    - MINOR: quic: use the same HP encryption helpers for RX and TX
    - BUG/MINOR: quic: valid NEW_TOKEN connections are counted as half-open
    - BUG/MEDIUM: cli: Fix parsing of big payloads with dynamically allocated buffer
    - BUG/MINOR: filters: fix silent compression disable with legacy "filter compression" first
    - MINOR: filters: Support the global side in filter_place_class()
    - OPTIMIZE: stream: Stop holding a reference on the frontend during stream_free()
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: Don't close the connection on a payload parsing error
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1: make the Connection/Upgrade headers cleanup idempotent
    - BUG/MINOR: h1: keep accepting unsafe violations after a parser reset
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1: don't rewrite the Upgrade header when not cleaning headers
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1-htx: don't stall on messages ending exactly at the buffer's end
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't truncate the response when closing after draining
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't truncate responses on soft-stop
    - BUG/MINOR: h1: don't use uninitialized start line pointers when restarting
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: only reset the session's timing info on the frontend side
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: fix the open streams counter on stream creation failure
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: wake the connection up when a pending error can be sent
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: don't dereference a NULL opposite sedesc in h1_fastfwd()
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1: reject CONNECT request targets other than "host:port"
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't lose the end of the previous chunk in h1_make_chunk()
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't stall when draining more than a buffer of data
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: reset the content-length/chunking state after a 1xx response
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: don't keep fast-forwarding disabled for the next streams
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: don't report a 408 error on timeout of a closed connection
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't swap buffers when transferring data with a reserved offset
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: report payload parsing glitches to the session
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't lose error responses once a content-length was parsed
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1: build a missing Host header from the authority of the URI
    - BUG/MINOR: h1: reject CONNECT authorities with an empty host
    - BUG/MINOR: h1: forget a previous pass' results when parsing headers only
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't send chunked responses to HTTP/1.0 clients
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: convert the <from> argument of h1-case-adjust to lower case
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h1: reject absolute http(s) URIs with an empty host
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: only rely on the client's method for bodyless responses
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: search the websocket key in the right message
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: don't forward request trailers named like server name header
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux-h1: don't spread-close idle conns with idle-close-on-response
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-h1: Don't subscribe for receives once read0 or error received
    - BUILD: makefile: better support git worktrees
    - BUG/MINOR: sym: don't crash on images linked at a fixed base
    - CI: github: run several weekly/monthly jobs daily
    - DOC: remove the AWS-LC CI image
    - BUG/MEDIUM: resolvers: reject too long labels when encoding a name
    - CI: github: fix VTest cache paths in container jobs
    - BUG/MAJOR: mux-quic: do not crash on connection error after glitch threshold
    - BUG/MAJOR: mux-h2: split absolute URIs like the HTTP analysers do on output
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h3: split absolute URIs like the HTTP analysers do on output
    - BUG/MINOR: filters: free the error message of the filter-config parsers
    - MINOR: filters: initialize the filter classes before the register stage
    - BUG/MEDIUM: bwlim: never burst more than the pending data in input
    - MINOR: filters: Move cache-store after decompression in global classes list
    - BUG/MINOR: sample: Fix wrong 'base64urldec' return value check in 'jwt_member_query'
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h3: fix BUG_ON() crash with glitch on SETTINGS parsing
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h3: fix BUG_ON() crash with glitch on GOAWAY parsing
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h3: fix BUG_ON() crash with glitch after QPACK dec err
    - MINOR: h3: remove dead code on h3_rcv_buf() error path
    - BUG/MINOR: h3: fix risk of BUG_ON() crash with glitch on unknown frame
    - BUG/MINOR: h3: fix BUG_ON() crash with glitch on htx_set_eom() failure
    - REGTESTS: filters: Fix the global filters order as reported on the CLI
    - Revert "BUG/MAJOR: mux-quic: do not crash on connection error after glitch threshold"
    - MEDIUM: filters: automatically order the implicit core filters in legacy mode
    - DOC: filters: document the automatic ordering of the legacy core filters
    - MEDIUM: filters: eval the backend instances first on the response path
    - MEDIUM: filters: eval the legacy backend filters first on the response path
    - BUG/MINOR: flt-decomp: Report error about filter order in lagacy mode only
    - BUG/MEDIUM: h3: fix memory corruption on trailers parsing realign
    - BUG/MINOR: mux_quic: wake streams on soft-stop using listener socket
    - BUG/MINOR: h3: enforce maxrewrite on request headers
    - BUG/MINOR: h3: fix crash with maxrewrite on response headers
    - BUG/MINOR: cfgparse/peers: warn and prevent undefined behavior when peers is missing bind info
    - BUG/MEDIUM: task: do not destroy twice the tasks already killed in mworker_cleantasks()
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux_quic: fix crash on QCS double remote close
    - BUG/MEDIUM: mux_quic: ensure FIN is reported after Rx data transfer
    - MINOR: thread: split out thread_bind_to_cpu_map()
    - OPTIM: fd: Make each thread group's FD table NUMA-local
    - OPTIM: fd: make each thread group's polled_mask NUMA-local
    - MINOR: ssl: Add new 'pha' server option
    - BUILD: thread: fix builds without thread support
    - DOC: config: add missing acme.scheduler in the global index
    - MINOR: tools: add find_word_index_in_array() to find a keyword
    - MINOR: http/config: add acceptable-http-re{quest,sponse}-violations
    - MINOR: http: add one control per existing HTTP violation
    - MEDIUM: http: add the "short-status-code" violation exception
    - BUG/MINOR: jwt: don't truncate binary HMAC secrets at the first NULL byte
    - BUG/MINOR: jws: fix ECDSA_SIG leak in jws_b64_signature()
    - BUG/MINOR: jwe: only accept exact "alg" and "enc" names in JWE tokens
    - BUG/MINOR: jwe: reject non-empty encrypted keys with "dir" and "ECDH-ES"
    - BUG/MINOR: jwe: only match the exact "ALL" word in jwt.decrypt_{alg,enc}_list
    - BUG/MINOR: jwt: enforce the ECDSA signature length in jwt_verify
    - BUG/MINOR: mux-quic: prevent send corruption on buf realign

data.name: 4.0.0 release
data.body: Pinpoint 4.0.0 is a **major release** that opens the 4.x line. It has three highlights: - **Service**, now on by default, groups applications so that each team can focus on its own service. - **OpenTelemetry Trace Support** brings applications instrumented with OpenTelemetry into Pinpoint without the Pinpoint agent. - **Service Alarm** is a renewed alarm system built around services. New **Alarm Templates** make it easy to set up the same alarms for many applications. It also adds Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring Framework 7.0 support and includes the agent-stability work that shipped in 3.1.1. This release changes defaults and removes several legacy code paths, so please read the **Upgrade guide** before upgrading in place from 3.1.x. ## Highlights ### Service (enabled by default) ![Service model](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F2967689678-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252F-MgQ1Is59jDrgEN5nG-0-3931491796%252Fuploads%252Fgit-blob-dfcb4828486d704cdf50df229824e92f7d072200%252Fservice_01.gif%3Falt%3Dmedia&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=1ad125734989224e670e0f3e61c66077&sv=3) Pinpoint 4.0.0 introduces the Service feature. You can group several applications into one service and see how services call each other on the Service Map. Screens that support the service feature show only the data of the applications in the selected service. - **Monitoring**: Focus on the data of the service you own and find the cause of a problem faster. - **Operations**: As applications grow, group them by service to keep the monitoring targets clear. Monitoring targets form a `Service → Application → Agent` hierarchy. The `demo-shop-commerce` service of the demo shopping mall looks like this: ``` Service: demo-shop-commerce products and orders ├─ Application: Shopping-Order order processing │ ├─ Agent: shop-order-01 │ └─ Agent: shop-order-02 └─ Application: Shopping-Product product lookup └─ Agent: shop-product-01 ``` Data that is not assigned to a service, such as data collected before the upgrade or sent by agents older than 4.0.0, stays in the `DEFAULT` service. Creating a new service does not move existing data into it. To use the service feature, create the service in the Web first, then set `pinpoint.serviceName` on the agents (see *Agent*). See the [Service guide](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/documents/service) for details. ### OpenTelemetry Trace Support Pinpoint 4.0.0 receives OpenTelemetry traces directly. Applications instrumented with the OpenTelemetry Java agent, any OTel SDK, or the OpenTelemetry Collector appear in the same server map, transaction list and call tree as agent-collected data, without the Pinpoint agent. * **OTLP over gRPC and HTTP** Traces are accepted over gRPC and over HTTP in both protobuf and JSON, with gzip and standard OTLP responses. Span time keeps nanosecond precision (#13923). * **URL Statistic and Error Analysis** URL Statistic is built from OTel server spans using the route template (#14229). Exceptions recorded on OTel spans flow into Error Analysis with multi-language stacktrace parsing (JVM, Go, Node.js, Python) and grouping by route (#14233). SQL text is shown in the call tree. * **Server map and service map links** Caller → callee edges between OTel-instrumented applications are drawn from a `pp` entry in the W3C `tracestate` header, written by the sender via [pinpoint-otel-extension](https://github.com/pinpoint-apm/pinpoint-otel-extension) (OpenTelemetry Java agent extension, plus guides for Java SDK, Python, Go and Node.js). When the caller cannot propagate it, the collector and a batch job join the two sides and fill in the edge (#14453). OTel span links open the linked transaction (#13596). * **Error log collection** The collector also receives OTLP logs. Exceptions that were caught and only logged are stored in Error Analysis and linked to the span they were logged in (#14299). * **Other changes** * GenAI spans are summarized in the call tree: the model that served the request, input/output token usage including cached tokens, and time to first token. * Sensitive span attributes are never stored: HTTP headers, credentials and tokens are dropped, and URL query strings and command-line arguments are stripped before the span is written. ### Service Alarm ![Service Alarm](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F2967689678-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252F-MgQ1Is59jDrgEN5nG-0-3931491796%252Fuploads%252Fgit-blob-d927bf77e1b88e427fc44b3aa70df21a7f33c7fa%252Fservice_alarm_01.png%3Falt%3Dmedia&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=3ce215faa289f31f0ccb56b52bd070f3&sv=3) ![Alarm Rules](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F2967689678-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252F-MgQ1Is59jDrgEN5nG-0-3931491796%252Fuploads%252Fgit-blob-0c70aee36c62357f5a6daeffbf6d8582d688fa83%252Fservice_alarm_03.jpg%3Falt%3Dmedia&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=27672959c09e39ba8d3020a8a020d2c3&sv=3) Alarms are rebuilt around services (#14282). The team that owns a service manages its rules and notification channels in one place. Alerts can be tuned to how serious a problem is, and each one leads straight to where you can investigate. Rules can watch response quality (slow and error rates, Apdex), calls to another application, agent resources (heap, CPU, connection pool) and deadlocks. Alarm Templates are sets of rules that you apply to many applications at once. Start from a built-in preset for agent health or response quality, or make your own. When you change a template, every application that uses it updates automatically. | | Legacy Alarm | Service Alarm | | --- | --- | --- | | Conditions | One metric per rule | Several metrics combined with AND / OR, so you can cut noisy alerts | | Severity | None | `WARNING` / `CRITICAL` | | Timing | Fixed 5-minute window, checked every 3 minutes | Window, check interval and repeat interval set per rule | | Setup | Rules registered one application at a time | Templates and built-in presets apply a rule set to many applications | | Channels | Configured on each rule | Email, SMS and webhook (Slack included) registered once per service and shared | | After an alert | No history in the UI | Rule status and firing history in the UI; notifications link to the Service Map or Inspector | See the full [Alarm comparison](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/documents/alarm#alarm-comparison) in the Alarm guide. Existing alarm rules are not migrated automatically, but a template lets you apply the same alarms to many applications at once. See *Upgrade guide → Service Alarm* before you switch. ### Agent * **Service name is now required (#14379).** Every agent starts with a service name that has been registered in the Web, and the agent ID is generated automatically instead of being set by hand. Agents configured the 3.x way do not start until a service name is added; the 3.1.x identifiers can still be chosen by configuration. * **Application type for services (#14455).** Applications in a service are shown as `JAVA` rather than as the detected server such as `TOMCAT` or `JETTY`, so icons and per-type statistics on the server map change. The previous behavior can be restored by configuration. * **Compressed transport (#14477).** Spans and statistics are sent compressed by default, reducing network traffic to the collector with no collector change. * **More reliable async tracing (#14391).** Async spans are no longer lost or reported as corrupted call stacks when their scope ends early. * Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring Framework 7.0 are supported; Spring Framework 3.x and 4.x are no longer supported. * New plugins: Apache Pekko HTTP (#13818) and Ktor client. * okhttp 4.x and 5.x are supported (#14221). * Tomcat 9 to 11 are supported (#14481); Tomcat 8 is no longer supported. ### Security - **Webhook host allowlist** (#13857): configured hosts may resolve into otherwise-rejected private ranges, closing the gap left by the 3.1.1 SSRF validation. Carries the 3.1.1 basic-login hardening (required JWT secret, `HttpOnly` cookie). ### Removals & cleanup - **Legacy server map v2 support removed** (#13905). - **Legacy application & agent list table (`ApplicationIndex`) support removed** (#14028). - **Legacy trace index table (`ApplicationTraceIndex`) support removed** (#14028). - The emptied `pinpoint-plugins-bom` module removed and plugin library versions declared explicitly (#14486); the `otlptrace-otel-extension` module removed in favor of `pinpoint-apm/pinpoint-otel-extension`. ## Upgrade guide ### Defaults that changed - **The service feature is on by default.** To restore 3.1.x behavior, set the three switches back to `false`: ```properties # web experimental.enableServiceMap.value=false pinpoint.modules.web.servicemap.enabled=false # collector pinpoint.collector.service.lookup.enabled=false ``` With the service feature off, the collector stores all data in the `DEFAULT` service, whatever service name the agent reports, and does not check that the service is registered. 4.0.0 agents still need `pinpoint.serviceName` to start: set it to `DEFAULT` so that the application type is detected as in 3.1.x (`TOMCAT`, `JETTY`, ...) instead of `JAVA`. - **Default `pinpoint.modules.uid.version` / NameVersion is now `v4`** (#14379). If the agent reports to a **collector older than 4.0.0**, pin it explicitly: ```properties pinpoint.modules.uid.version=v3 ``` - **Agent gRPC compression is on by default.** It is backward compatible, but to disable it: ```properties profiler.transport.grpc.span.batch-sender.compression=none profiler.transport.grpc.stat.sender.compression=none ``` ### Service Alarm - Service Alarm is evaluated and sent by the new `alarm-batch-starter` process. It needs MySQL, Spring Batch metadata, HBase and Pinot. The agent statistics table settings (`alarm.agent-stat.table.prefix`, `padding-length`, `count`) are required, or startup fails. - The legacy alarm still runs in the `batch` module, for the `DEFAULT` service only. - Legacy alarm rules are not migrated automatically. Re-register them as Service Alarm rules; the [Alarm guide](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/documents/alarm) maps each legacy checker to its Service Alarm equivalent. - Legacy SMS, email and webhook settings are not migrated either. If you enable the same condition in both systems, you get duplicate notifications. - Service Alarm requires the service feature. With `pinpoint.modules.web.servicemap.enabled=false`, only the legacy alarm screen appears. - The alarm API has `@PreAuthorize` hooks for a custom permission evaluator. Open-source Web does not enable method security, so these hooks are not enforced by default: anyone who can access the Web can view and change the rules, channels and templates of every service. ### Schema Upgrading to 4.0.0 requires the schema changes below. See [Schema changes in 4.0.0](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/documents/service#id-7.-4.0.0). - **MySQL 5.x is no longer supported.** 4.0.0 requires MySQL 8.4+; upgrade MySQL before upgrading Pinpoint if you run 5.7 (end of life since October 2023). - **Pinot**: add the `serviceName` column (STRING, default `DEFAULT`) to the `exceptionTrace` table (`pinot-exceptionTrace-schema.json`). - **MySQL** (8.4+, configuration columns use the JSON type): - Create the `service` table with `Service-Schema.sql`. - Create the alarm tables with `CreateTableStatement-mysql.sql`: `alarm_template`, `alarm_template_item`, `alarm_rule_v2`, `alarm_rule_local_config`, `alarm_notification_channel`, `alarm_channel_binding`, `alarm_state`, `alarm_history_v2`, `alarm_notification_outbox`. - Create the Spring Batch metadata for Alarm Batch with `SpringBatchJobRepositorySchema-mysql.sql`; Alarm Batch does not create it automatically. - **HBase**: add the tables listed in [HBase table changes for 3.1.0](https://pinpoint-apm.gitbook.io/pinpoint/documents/hbase-table-changes#id-3.1.0) (`MapAppSelf`, `MapAgentSelf`, `MapAppOut`, `MapAppIn`, `MapAppHost`, `TraceIndex`, `Application`, `AgentId`) if they do not exist yet. Downgrading a 4.0.0 collector back to 3.1.x in place is not supported. ### Removed configuration - The deprecated XML batch configuration and `EnableBatchProcessing` are removed — batch runs on the annotation-based config only (#13830). ### Build - Build JDK is 17; minimum Maven is 3.9.0 (the bundled `mvnw` is unaffected). ## Compatibility | Component | Requirement | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Agent JDK | 8+ | verified on 8 / 11 / 17 / 21 / 25 | | Collector / Web / Batch JDK | 17 | | | Collector for agent 4.0.0 | 4.0.0+ | with the default `uid.version=v4`; pin `v3` for older collectors | | MySQL | 8.4+ | new `service` and alarm tables | | Pinot schema | migration | `serviceName` column added to `exceptionTrace` | | HBase schema | migration | add tables (`MapApp*`, `MapAgentSelf`, `TraceIndex`, `Application`, `AgentId`) | | Build Maven | 3.9.0+ | | --- ## Downloads Binaries are attached to this release: - pinpoint-agent-4.0.0.tar.gz - pinpoint-batch-4.0.0-exec.jar - pinpoint-alarm-batch-starter-4.0.0-exec.jar - pinpoint-collector-4.0.0-exec.jar - pinpoint-collector-starter-4.0.0-exec.jar - pinpoint-web-4.0.0-exec.jar - pinpoint-web-starter-4.0.0-exec.jar ## data.name: v2.8.7
data.body:
This patch release fixes JVMChaos, StressChaos, RemoteCluster readiness, and PhysicalMachineChaos lifecycle handling. It also adds workflow task configuration options and includes dependency security updates.

### Added

- Support `serviceAccountName` for Workflow Task pods [#5162](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5162)
- Support `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` for workflow task pods [#4790](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4790)

### Changed

- Migrate the Docker runtime client to the maintained Moby SDK. Automatic API negotiation requires Docker Engine 19.03 or later. [#5165](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5165)
- Upgrade tproxy to [v0.5.7](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-tproxy/releases/tag/v0.5.7) to fix HTTPChaos lifecycle cleanup and preserve repeated HTTP values. [#5170](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5170)
- Upgrade toda to v0.3.0 to remove empty backing directories after IOChaos recovery [#5138](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5138)
- Upgrade byteman-helper to v4.0.27-0.12 for Java 25 compatibility [#5098](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5098)
- Build Go components with Go 1.26.10 and upgrade Delve to v1.26.3 for debugging. [#5172](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5172)

### Fixed

- Fix JVMChaos preparation failures in containers that use Rust coreutils [#5161](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5161)
- Fix RemoteCluster readiness after successful setup, reconciliation failures, and deletion [#5157](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5157)
- Treat physical-machine process signals without recovery as one-shot actions to prevent repeated injection and blocked deletion [#5143](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/5143)
- Fix JVM latency injection on JDK 19 and later [#4821](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4821)
- Fix a StressChaos nil pointer dereference when only `stressngStressors` is configured [#4936](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4936)
- Fix StressChaos injection failures when inactive cgroup v1 controller directories are present. [#4407](https://github.com/chaos-mesh/chaos-mesh/pull/4407)

### Security

data.name: BFE v1.8.9.1
data.body:
### Added
- Add `Server.AIUpstreamAcceptEncoding` (`auto`/`identity`/`off`, default `auto`): how `Accept-Encoding` is rewritten on an AI upstream request, so content negotiation stays inside the coding set the gateway can decode (`gzip`, `deflate`). `auto` keeps only the decodable codings of the client's list (q values preserved, an empty intersection is left untouched, `identity;q=0` is honoured), `identity` strips compression for diagnostics, `off` keeps the previous behaviour. The rewrite only touches the outbound header: the inbound request, the access log, `mod_ai_cache` and `mod_compress` still see the client value (issue #1468)
- Add `bfe_util.NewContentDecoder` / `CanDecodeContentEncoding` / `SupportedContentEncodings`, a streaming `Content-Encoding` decoder covering `gzip`/`x-gzip` and `deflate` (zlib header sniffed, raw DEFLATE accepted). `DecodeContentEncoding` now delegates to it, so the non-streaming parse-only copy also understands `deflate` (issue #1468)
- Add the `ResStreamCompressed` / `ResStreamDecoded` / `ResStreamDecodeSkipped` / `ResStreamRawOnly` `mod_body_process` counters: how many responses carried a `Content-Encoding`, how many got the decompress-for-parsing tap, how many could not be decoded and how many degraded mid-stream. The last two mean "this request is billed by estimation", i.e. the only signal that an upstream ignored the narrowed `Accept-Encoding` (issue #1468)

### Changed
- An AI upstream request whose client `Accept-Encoding` contains codings the gateway cannot decode no longer receives them (`Server.AIUpstreamAcceptEncoding = auto`, the default): the upstream is offered `gzip`/`deflate` only, so a client that asked for `zstd` may now receive `gzip` instead (still inside its own `Accept-Encoding`, <1% size difference). Set `Server.AIUpstreamAcceptEncoding = off` to keep the previous negotiation (issue #1468)

### Fixed
- Parse the usage of a compressed streaming (SSE) response instead of estimating it: `mod_body_process` bypassed any `Content-Encoding` body to a byte-wise pass-through, so `cache_read_tokens` stayed 0, `prompt_tokens` fell back to the request-body estimate and `completion_tokens` to the compressed-bytes estimate, and the whole prompt was billed at the input price — measured on the field at a 96% cache-hit rate that overcharges by roughly 46x and writes `ai_usage_source=estimated`. Compressed SSE now goes through `CompressedStreamDecoder`, which tees the source into a decompressor used only for parsing while the original compressed bytes are forwarded verbatim together with the `Content-Encoding` header; a decompression failure or an unsupported coding degrades to a byte-exact pass-through plus the estimate, visibly (issue #1468)
- Report a skipped `stream_options.include_usage` injection when the request body exceeds `Server.AccessibleBodySize`: the injection used to fail silently, which raised the probability of an upstream returning no usage at all (issue #1468)

## Changelog

Refer to the [2.15 Upgrade Guide](https://docs.nats.io/release-notes/upgrade-to-2.15) for backwards compatibility notes with 2.14.x.

### Go Version

- 1.27.3, which contains mitigations for CVE-2026-111943 by distrusting eMudhra intermediate certificates (#8798)

### Dependencies

- github.com/klauspost/compress v1.20.3 (#8798)
- golang.org/x/crypto v0.58.0 (#8798)
- golang.org/x/sys v0.49.0 (#8798)

### Fixed

General

- Allowed connection types are now correctly respected in auth callout setups
- Fixed a potential queue sub weight amplification in the sublist
- OCSP responses are now correctly bound to the certificate serial number

JetStream

- Restored v1 stream snapshots now correctly guard against excessive subject lengths, subject counts or block counts

Leafnodes

- ACLs on leafnode connections no longer override allow/deny lists to implicitly allow `$MQTT.>` permissions

MQTT

- OCSP verification for MQTT connections now correctly obeys the `ocsp_peer` option in the `mqtt` block

### Complete Changes

https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/compare/v2.15.1...v2.15.2

data.name: v1.155.0
data.body:
## [v1.155.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.155.0)

Released at 2026-10-23

**Update Note 1:** `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): `/admin/tenants` requests without `start` and `end` query args now return tenants for the current day. This is a breaking change because previously it was expected to return all tenants. If you still need to retrieve all tenants, set the `start` and `end` params so that the resulting time range fully includes the `-retentionPeriod`. Also note that [vmctl](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/) is known to send requests to `/admin/tenants` under the hood when migrating data between VictoriaMetrics deployments. Therefore, make sure that you run `vmctl` with both `*-filter-time-start` and `*-filter-time-end` params. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#11791](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

* SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.2 to Go1.27.3. See [the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.3](https://github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).
* SECURITY: upgrade base docker image (Alpine) from 3.24.2 to 3.24.3. See [Alpine 3.24.4 release notes](https://alpinelinux.org/posts/Alpine-3.21.9-3.22.7-3.23.7-3.24.3-released.html).

* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add `-healthcheck` command-line flag, which checks that the running process accepts connections at `-httpListenAddr` and exits with non-zero code if the check fails. This allows setting up Docker `HEALTHCHECK` in images without `curl` or `wget`. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/url-examples/#health) and [VictoriaLogs#1565](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1565).
* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: expose `process_cpu_cores_host`, `process_cpu_cores_cgroup_quota`, `process_memory_host_bytes` and `process_memory_cgroup_bytes` metrics. Cgroup metrics are `-1` if no cgroup limit is set or the limit cannot be read. See [#11460](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11460).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): deprecate Server URL editing and show a warning when using a saved custom URL. Existing custom URLs continue to work. See [#11735](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11735).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): update the appearance of error, warning, info, and success messages. See [#11736](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11736).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): add a tenant column to Top Queries and Active Queries when tenant information is available. See [#6346](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/6346).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): limit tenant discovery to the selected time range. See [#11784](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11784).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): limit the number of logged parse errors per each scrape of a target via `-promscrape.maxParseErrorsPerScrape` command-line flag (20 by default). The number of suppressed parse errors is logged after the scrape. This prevents log flooding from targets exposing many malformed lines. See [#8856](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/8856).
* FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): restore Prometheus compatibility for alerts state restoration, so Prometheus can be used as `-remoteRead.url` again. Previously, the restore query used MetricsQL function `default_rollup()` which Prometheus rejects, so the state of alerting rules with `for > 0` was reset on every vmalert restart. See [#11574](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11574).
* FEATURE: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): export `vm_request_duration_seconds{path="/admin/tenants"}` for tracking time it takes to fetch [tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) from the database.
* FEATURE: [dashboards](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/tree/master/dashboards): apply the instance filter to the `CPU pressure`, `Memory pressure`, `IO pressure`, and `Memory allocations rate` panels in the Resource usage section of the [VictoriaMetrics - cluster](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/11176-victoriametrics-cluster/) dashboard. Displays zero disk I/O and syscall rates. See [#11742](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11742).
* FEATURE: [alerts-health](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-health.yml): add `TooManySnapshots` alerting rule. It notifies about instances where more than 2 [snapshots](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-work-with-snapshots) are stored for at least 2 hours. Such snapshots are usually left behind by failed `vmbackup` / `vmbackupmanager` runs. They keep references to the already merged data parts and prevent [background merges](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#storage) from freeing the disk space, which results in excessive disk usage. See [#9344](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/9344).

* BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): prevent [Kafka remote write](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/) getting stuck after TLS certificates are reloaded. Previously, when vmagent detected changed certificates and restarted the Kafka producer, pending sends to the old producer could hang forever and the remote write queue stopped draining until vmagent was restarted. Now such sends are retried with the new producer. See [#11737](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11737).
* BUGFIX: `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent metric metadata drops after transient RPC handshake timeouts when connecting to `vmstorage`. See [#11762](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11762). Thanks to @sakateka for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly validate time series ingested via [`/api/v1/import/native`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-import-data-in-native-format). See [#11745](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11745). Thanks to @meshchellomishel for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): reduce memory usage during for Kubernetes service discovery, when scrape configuration has many entries that matches small subset of targets. See [#11751](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11751). Thanks to @CamberLoid for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent search requests panic. See [#11788](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11788) for details.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): set `__meta_kubernetes_namespace` and the namespace metadata to the namespace of the `Endpoints` or `EndpointSlice` object in [`role: endpoints`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#kubernetes_sd_configs) and `role: endpointslice` service discovery when the referenced pod lives in another namespace. Previously the namespace of the pod was used, unlike Prometheus. See [#11798](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11798). Thanks to @cestercian for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): skip keys with unsupported `kty` or `crv`, missing required members or invalid values in the JWKS fetched via [OIDC discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#oidc-discovery) instead of rejecting the whole key set, as required by [RFC 7517](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7517#section-5). Previously, a single unsupported or malformed key in the JWKS caused vmauth to reject all JWTs from that issuer, including tokens signed with supported keys. See [#11748](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11748).
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): stop saving the automatically calculated query step in shared URLs, so opening a link recalculates the step for the selected time range and screen width. Explicitly configured steps remain fixed. See [#11638](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11638).
* BUGFIX: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): change the default time range for [/admin/tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) HTTP endpoint to search tenants only for the current day instead of searching the entire `[0, now]` time range. This should prevent unnecessary load on `vmstorage` and prevent OOMs. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#11791](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

Bump version to 19.4.48 by Chef Expeditor

Obvious fix; these changes are the result of automation not creative thinking.

REKOR_UUID=108e9186e8c5677ac8e702d8f174d6509e26698a2f0c98fe78c04629b3a92414e2e9ae50696b433c

data.name: v3.7.3
data.body:
Please check out [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/blob/main/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-3.7.md) for a full list of changes. And make sure to read [upgrade guide](https://etcd.io/docs/v3.7/upgrades/upgrade_3_7/) before upgrading etcd (there may be breaking changes).

For installation guides, please check out [play.etcd.io](http://play.etcd.io) and [operating etcd](https://etcd.io/docs/v3.7/op-guide/). Latest support status for common architectures and operating systems can be found at [supported platforms](https://etcd.io/docs/v3.7/op-guide/supported-platform/).

###### Linux

```sh
ETCD_VER=v3.7.3

# choose either URL
GOOGLE_URL=https://storage.googleapis.com/etcd
GITHUB_URL=https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download
DOWNLOAD_URL=${GOOGLE_URL}

rm -f /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
rm -rf /tmp/etcd-download-test && mkdir -p /tmp/etcd-download-test

curl -L ${DOWNLOAD_URL}/${ETCD_VER}/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
tar xzvf /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C /tmp/etcd-download-test --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner
rm -f /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz

/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd --version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdutl version

# start a local etcd server
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd

# write,read to etcd
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl --endpoints=localhost:2379 put foo bar
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl --endpoints=localhost:2379 get foo
```

###### macOS (Darwin)

```sh
ETCD_VER=v3.7.3

# choose either URL
GOOGLE_URL=https://storage.googleapis.com/etcd
GITHUB_URL=https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download
DOWNLOAD_URL=${GOOGLE_URL}

rm -f /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64.zip
rm -rf /tmp/etcd-download-test && mkdir -p /tmp/etcd-download-test

curl -L ${DOWNLOAD_URL}/${ETCD_VER}/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64.zip -o /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64.zip
unzip /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64.zip -d /tmp && rm -f /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64.zip
mv /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64/* /tmp/etcd-download-test && rm -rf mv /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64

/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd --version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdutl version
```

###### Docker

etcd uses [`gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd`](https://gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd) as a primary container registry, and [`quay.io/coreos/etcd`](https://quay.io/coreos/etcd) as secondary.

```sh
ETCD_VER=v3.7.3

rm -rf /tmp/etcd-data.tmp && mkdir -p /tmp/etcd-data.tmp && \
  docker rmi gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd:${ETCD_VER} || true && \
  docker run \
  -p 2379:2379 \
  -p 2380:2380 \
  --mount type=bind,source=/tmp/etcd-data.tmp,destination=/etcd-data \
  --name etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} \
  gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd:${ETCD_VER} \
  /usr/local/bin/etcd \
  --name s1 \
  --data-dir /etcd-data \
  --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
  --advertise-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
  --listen-peer-urls http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-cluster s1=http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-cluster-token tkn \
  --initial-cluster-state new \
  --log-level info \
  --logger zap \
  --log-outputs stderr

docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcd --version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdutl version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl endpoint health
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl put foo bar
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl get foo
```

data.name: v2.2.1
data.body:
### October 22, 2026

SECURITY:

* containers/alpine: Upgrade ca-certificates-bundle to 20261020-r0 to distrust eMudhra intermediate chains.
* containers/UBI: explicitly disallow emSign Root CA and Comodo AAA Services in the CA trust store to distrust eMudhra intermediate chains.
* core/policy: Fixed a cache-key collision vulnerability that could cause policy-name aliases to resolve to the immutable root policy. Root-policy aliases are now explicitly rejected at entity, group, token, authentication-response, and agent-registry policy assignment boundaries. Previously accepted root-equivalent policy aliases (e.g., "./root", "a/../root") are now rejected.

CHANGES:

* core: Bump Go version to 1.27.3 to resolve CVE-2026-111943.

IMPROVEMENTS:

* agent: Add auto auth SPIFFE method.

BUG FIXES:

* core/quotas (enterprise): Fixed a bug where role-based quotas would fail to determine roles where the role is stored as `form-data`.
* identity (enterprise): Fix updates to tpmgroup membership not taking effect on active node when the tpmgroup by-name endpoint is used for the update. Reads showed the change applied to storage, but the inmem index wasn't updated.
* identity/scim (enterprise): Fix `POST /Users` returning 409 instead of adopting an unmanaged entity whose name matches the `userName`, such as after `unlink-entity`. Adoption now depends only on the matching alias, and the name conflict check applies only when a new entity is created.
* managed-keys (enterprise): Fix wrapper error in using managed keys for MACs
* secrets/database/mssql: Safely quote database and user identifiers during default user revocation and parameterize principal lookups, so that logins whose names contain characters outside the database code page are removed rather than left disabled. Default password rotation now quotes the username and escapes the password.
storage/mssql, storage/mysql: Escape configured SQL identifiers when constructing storage queries.
* transit (enterprise): Fix key check to allow use of managed keys for HMAC
* transit (enterprise): Fix error with using CMAC keys after rotation from an HMAC key using the Rotate with Algorithm Change endpoint
* transit (enterprise): Fix error with using managed keys for datakey generation after rotation using the Rotate with Algorithm Change endpoint
* ui: Fix MFA form breadcrumbs rendering in enforcement section, updated radio cards to use HDS
ci(helm): Bump update-helm-repo pin past blocked app-token SHA (#25558)

data.name: Release 2.45.3 LTS
data.body:
## Known issues

- On Async Edge environments, an invalid update schedule date can be displayed when browsing a snapshot

### Known issues with Podman support

- Podman environments aren't supported by auto-onboarding script
- It's not possible to add Podman environments via socket, when running a Portainer server on Docker (and vice versa)
- Support for only CentOS 9, Podman 5 rootful

## Changes

### Breaking changes

- Portainer no longer trusts TLS certificates issued by eMudhra (emSign), following the compromise of eight eMudhra intermediate CAs (CVE-2026-111943). Connections to services that present an affected certificate, including OAuth/OIDC and LDAPS providers, registries and Git hosts, will fail after the upgrade. If your single sign-on or LDAP provider is affected, only the initial admin will be able to sign in. Check your services before upgrading. [See this FAQ for details.](https://hubs.li/Q04B-qY30)

### Security improvements

- Rejected Compose and Swarm stacks using `volumes_from` when non-administrators create, update, start or redeploy them with `Hide bind mounts for non-administrators` enabled, which let them inherit another container's host bind mounts
- Updated the Go toolchain to 1.26.10, fixing CVE-2026-56857 and CVE-2026-78663 (both Critical), along with CVE-2026-111943, CVE-2026-97032, CVE-2026-97031, CVE-2026-94440, CVE-2026-94439, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-78667, CVE-2026-78660, CVE-2026-78659, CVE-2026-56866, CVE-2026-94448 and CVE-2026-97030
- Removed the eMudhra emSign root certificates from the CA bundle in Linux images, and rejected certificate chains that contain the compromised eMudhra intermediates (CVE-2026-111943). [See this FAQ for details.](https://hubs.li/Q04B-qY30)
- Updated [golang.org/x/net](http://golang.org/x/net) to 0.60.0, fixing CVE-2026-78663 (Critical), CVE-2026-97032, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-78660 and CVE-2026-78659 (all High)
- Updated helm in the kubectl shell image to v4.3.1, taking its Go toolchain to 1.27.2 and oras.land/oras-go/v2 to 2.6.2, fixing CVE-2026-39821 (Critical) and CVE-2026-50163 (High)
- Restricted kubeconfig tokens to the /api/endpoints/{id}/kubernetes proxy, so they are rejected with a 403 on every other API route, including admin-only routes and the Docker proxy. Kubeconfigs downloaded after upgrading carry a separate token per environment, limited to that environment 

### Bug fixes

- Fixed starting a container with an empty request body failing with a 400 error on Docker standalone and Swarm agent environments 
- Fixed GitOps sources starting a new poll while the previous one was still running, which could pile up overlapping redeploys on slow repositories. A poll that is still running now causes the next scheduled poll to be skipped
- Fixed GitOps workflows showing the Git reference and file path status as unknown after a stack was manually redeployed from Git. A manual redeploy now records these statuses for the stack's workflow artifact
- Fixed the YAML tab on the Kubernetes node details page going blank after switching tabs or refocusing the browser, and restored the missing gap between the tab content and the Applications table
- Fixed DockerHub pull rate limits and agent version detection failing on Docker engines newer than API 1.47, and, in BE, non-admin users with environment access getting 403 errors on `/agent/docker` and `/agent/host` routes, which left Swarm node selectors empty
- Fixed the search box on the Authentication logs page not filtering events by username

## Deprecated and removed features

None.

data.name: pack v0.40.10
data.body:
## Prerequisites

- A container runtime such as [Docker](https://www.docker.com/get-started) or [podman](https://podman.io/get-started) must be available to execute builds.

## Install

For instructions on installing `pack`, see our [installation docs](https://buildpacks.io/docs/tools/pack/cli/install/).

## Run

Run the command `pack`.

You should see the following output

```text
CLI for building apps using Cloud Native Buildpacks

Usage:
  pack [command]

Available Commands:
  build                 Generate app image from source code
  builder               Interact with builders
  buildpack             Interact with buildpacks
  extension             Interact with extensions
  config                Interact with your local pack config file
  inspect               Show information about a built app image
  stack                 (deprecated) Interact with stacks
  rebase                Rebase app image with latest run image
  sbom                  Interact with SBoM
  completion            Outputs completion script location
  report                Display useful information for reporting an issue
  version               Show current 'pack' version
  help                  Help about any command

Flags:
      --force-color   Force color output
  -h, --help          Help for 'pack'
      --no-color      Disable color output
  -q, --quiet         Show less output
      --timestamps    Enable timestamps in output
  -v, --verbose       Show more output
      --version       Show current 'pack' version

Use "pack [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```

## Info

Builders created with this release of the pack CLI contain [lifecycle v0.21.0](https://github.com/buildpack/lifecycle/releases/tag/v0.21.0) by default.

## Changelog

**This is a security-only patch release.** No feature work, no API change, no
intended behaviour change. If you are on v0.40.9, this is a drop-in upgrade.

### Security

Measured with the same scanner and vulnerability database, no suppressions applied:

| Image | Findings | Critical | High | Medium | **With a fix available** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buildpacksio/pack:0.40.9` | 25 | 1 | 16 | 7 | **21** |
| `buildpacksio/pack:0.40.10` | **5** | 0 | 1 | 3 | **1** |
| default lifecycle, before (`0.21.0`) | 61 | 4 | 36 | 18 | **53** |
| default lifecycle, after (`0.21.25`) | **5** | 2 | 1 | 1 | **0** |

#### Toolchain

* Bump Go to 1.26.9 and security-relevant dependencies (#2713)
* Bump Go to 1.26.10 for CVE-2026-111943 (#2720)

#### Dependencies

| Module | Bump | Advisory | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `golang.org/x/crypto` | v0.54.0 → v0.57.0 | `CVE-2026-78662`, `CVE-2026-56855` — DoS on deadlocked `ssh` channels | — |
| `golang.org/x/net` *(indirect)* | v0.56.0 → v0.60.0 | `CVE-2026-78659/78660/78663/78669/97032` — HTTP/2 memory exhaustion, malformed framing headers, double flow-control refund, HPACK encoder race | — |
| `github.com/moby/go-archive` | v0.2.0 → v0.3.3 | `GHSA-hfg8-hc9c-6c3h` / `CVE-2026-17106` — crafted tar can write outside the extraction directory | **High** |
| `github.com/moby/sys/user` | v0.4.0 → v0.4.1 | `GHSA-mjcv-p78q-w5fw` / `CVE-2026-61801` — DoS via unbounded parsing of user/group files | Moderate |


#### Still outstanding, and why

| Advisory | Why it remains |
| --- | --- |
| `GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6` (buildkit, Medium) | **The one finding with an available fix.** It describes a custom BuildKit *frontend* disabling Seccomp/AppArmor during a solve. `pack` never runs a solve — it links only `frontend/dockerfile/{command,instructions,linter,parser,shell}` and `util/{stack,suggest}`; `solver`, `executor`, `frontend/gateway`, `client` and `session` are absent. The fix needs buildkit v0.31.1 → go-containerregistry v0.21.6 → an imgutil bump, so it is held for 0.41.0. |
| `GO-2026-4883`, `GO-2026-4887` (docker/docker) | Daemon-side code paths. `pack` only ever uses Docker as a client. Fixed only in `moby/moby` v2. |
| `GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3` (docker/distribution, Medium) | Missing digest verification in `registry/client.(*manifests).Get`. No `ManifestService` is ever constructed — the only importer of that package in the whole linked set uses three HTTP error helpers. No fix exists for the v2 module. |
| `GO-2026-6225` (`docker-credential-acr-env`) | Unmaintained upstream, no fixed version. Severity Unknown. Left **visible** in scan output rather than suppressed. |


### Bugs

* Pass the format string directly to `Debugf` (#2712)

### Maintenance

* Propagate the Go 1.26 bump to the hard-coded Go pins (#2715)
* Fix the duplicate-issue search in the release canary (#2716)
* Assert the annotation we set, not the total annotation count (#2717)
* Don't assert temp-dir cleanup on Windows in the registry buildpack test (#2722)

### Breaking changes

None.

### Upgrade notes

* Contributors need Go **1.26.10+** locally. `make verify` builds `golangci-lint`  with the *system* Go, so a system Go whose language version trails `go.mod` fails lint even though CI passes.
* Builders rebuilt with this release pick up lifecycle **0.21.25**. Existing builders are unaffected until rebuilt.

## Contributors

We'd like to acknowledge that this release wouldn't be as good without the help of the following amazing contributors:

@jjbustamante
